findings.description: Filter fields no longer count as unsent text in `typing()`, so the board is held only while the filter has focus. If a board change is held while you type in a filter and you then press Next/Previous or a row's Launch/Close, the focusout flush swaps the board before the click lands. The button is detached and the first press does nothing; Debt's `<details>` also re-collapses. A `pointerdown` guard on `.list-tools`, or deferring flush while a pointer is down in the board, would fix it.

The exported `ListWindow` interface is declared inline in a `*.service.ts` file. general.md §Type separation says: "Never inline an exported or reused `type`/`interface` in a `*.service.ts` or `*.routes.ts` file". Move it to a `*.types.ts` file under `src/core/types/`. `WebDashboard` and `DashboardBind` in this file already break the rule.

The JSDoc on `LIST_PAGE_ROWS` (`Rows a marked list shows per page.`) restates the constant's name and does not say why it is 20. general.md §No hardcoded values asks for a JSDoc line "saying what the number means and why it is that number".

`listWindow`'s `size` parameter has a single production caller, which passes the constant 20; only one test passes a different size. Hard-coding the page size inside `listWindow` would drop the parameter, the `LIST_PAGE_ROWS` const and its `${LIST_PAGE_ROWS}` interpolation. The paging tests' 45-row fixtures already exceed 20.

`ListWindow` is exported only for one type annotation in `web-dashboard.test.ts`. `toEqual` already checks the shape, so dropping the export, or using `ReturnType<typeof listWindow>` in the test, removes an export and an import.
